observations: Three laminated paper assemblies surround a central open space. Two upright green leaves fold outward; the terracotta lower assembly bends at both shoulders. Thin pale cores are visible at the edges. There is no backing plate or enclosing border. The pale green right leaf renders nearly white; material credibility, small-size readability and brand specificity still need independent review. This is a source-identical replay after canonical worktree consolidation, not a new visual decision. The proposed constant-stock/lap-joint source remains unrendered because its plan is unsettled.
